# Andrea Dugarte

> Business student at TETR College of Business (BMT 2029). AI agents, e-commerce, data and content. Contact: andrea.dugarte_bmt2029@tetr.com

## Work
- Red del Vino (Digital growth and e-commerce): Turned an information site for a wine network into a multilingual online shop, as the only person on it. 4 to 24 wines in 4 languages, live at reddelvino.com. Instagram interactions went from 704 to 4,599 in a month (+553%), net new followers from +13 to +576, and interactions per view from 1.7% to 4.1%.
- EVAA Media (Influencer business, RedNote): Built a RedNote account from zero and reported on it every month. 3x the followers and 4x the likes and saves of the runner-up in my cohort.
- TETR (Content creation, Instagram): Spokesperson and explainer videos for TETR's official channels. 10K+ views on spokesperson videos.
- InfluChina (AI operations): Set up and oversaw AI agents for lead handling and proposals at an agency that sells influencer marketing to foreign brands entering China. Also planned client WeChat content and built Google Ads creatives. Agents for leads and proposals, plus an 8-week LinkedIn content plan.
- Paperplane (Brand marketing and Instagram): Brand marketing and Instagram for a family-travel brand, with an AI agent I built. Published carousels began as my ideas.
- One Off Hotels (Content strategy): Conceived a Varanasi series, wrote the scripts and ran the on-camera interviews. On camera for the Delhi hotel. Featured on One Off's website and Instagram.
- Match It (Co-founder, D2C matcha brand): Led the website, the supplier relationship and in-person sales, one of six co-founders. Top salesperson at the live pop-up. The launch reel earned 3,500+ likes, the #1 video in the cohort.
- Luluah Beauty (Product research and e-commerce): Researched beauty products for the website and judged their commercial potential. Contributed to product selection.
- Brand partnerships (Business development): Cold outreach to local brands. 4 partnerships secured myself: OO La Labs, Deep Dive Dubai, Kompay, Chocoberry Boutique.

## Skills
AI tools and agents (Claude, Claude Code, ChatGPT), workflow automation, Excel with Pivot Tables, Tableau, data analysis and reporting.

## Languages
